mostWorthwhile.text: Building the capillary bed was most worthwhile because its thin walls connected the construction to exchange between blood and the fluid around cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to connect the artery directly to the capillary branches was the least clear passage: the result did not explain why the branches needed preparation first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the capillary branches needed an endothelial lining before they could connect to the artery.

arbitrary.text: The need to prepare the capillary bed first became understandable, although the initial failed combination did not make that requirement clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue into another chapter: assembling the route made the different vessel roles easier to follow, and I would be curious to see how it connects to the rest of the body.
